# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| 0.3.x   | ✅        |
| < 0.3   | ❌        |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Do not open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Please report vulnerabilities through one of these channels:

1. **GitHub Private Advisory** (preferred): [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/portbusy/smart-presence-notify/security/advisories/new)
2. **Email**: contact the maintainer at the address listed on the GitHub profile.

### What to include

- A clear description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce or a proof-of-concept
- The affected version(s)
- Any suggested mitigation or fix

### Response timeline

| Stage | Target |
| ----- | ------ |
| Initial acknowledgement | Within 72 hours |
| Status update | Within 7 days |
| Fix or mitigation | Within 30 days for critical issues |

All valid reports will receive credit in the release notes unless anonymity is requested.
